decision_config.important_boundary: The formal PASS/HOLD decision CLI was not run for the B3_25D-only provisional report. Do not describe the values below as an independently sealed decision-config file.

provisional_evaluation_semantics.close_baseline_non_inferiority: diagnostic gate recorded in the provisional decision; exact independent config binding is unresolved
provisional_evaluation_semantics.time_since_close: diagnostic comparator, not an independently proven formal gate

aggregation_semantics.reported_mean_rates: unweighted arithmetic mean of the 12 fold-seed run rates
aggregation_semantics.reported_max_rates: maximum of the 12 fold-seed run rates
aggregation_semantics.event_hit_denominator: eligible T10 events within each validation run
aggregation_semantics.later_event_denominator: later-event eligible events within each validation run
aggregation_semantics.negative_denominator: negative episodes within each validation run
aggregation_semantics.release_overlap: count of emitted events overlapping release windows; zero is the frozen pass condition
aggregation_semantics.micro_pooled_rates: not used for the frozen provisional gate and not inferred from the macro report

source_dtype_boundary.detector_prediction: float32 unless separately stated by a future protocol
source_dtype_boundary.OpenVLA/source_collection: the collection environment was A800/CUDA/BF16-capable; this does not imply BF16 detector training
